source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
As the step of declaring battle formations begins, this unit can join another unit of yours that a **CRYPTEK** model is leading. A unit can take at most one Tomb Crawlers unit, and cannot take a **CRYPTOTHRALLS** unit as well as a **TOMB CRAWLERS** unit.

If this unit joins, each of its models belongs to that Bodyguard unit for the rest of the battle, and the **Starting Strength** of that unit rises to match.

detail.trigger: start of Declare Battle Formations step
